hook: A matrix whose numerical range has constant width must have a disk as its numerical range.
summary: The author proves a conjecture of Chien, Nakazato, and Meng that a finite complex matrix with constant-width numerical range has a disk-shaped range. The argument uses a common factor of the characteristic polynomials of a Hermitian pencil and its translate, which forces the extreme eigenvalue to be a first harmonic. It applies to finite matrices only.
title: A proof of the constant-width numerical range conjecture
